content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays several key roles in MGNREGA registration [E01]: (1) It verifies household details including whether the household is a legitimate entity, whether applicants are local residents, and whether they are adult members [E01]. (2) The verification process must be completed within a fortnight of receiving the application [E01]. (3) Once eligible, the GP enters all particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system [E01]. (4) Within a fortnight of the application, the GP issues a Job Card to the eligible household [E01]. (5) Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office [E02].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"The GP verifies household details including legitimacy of the entity, local residency, and adult membership status","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Verification must be completed within a fortnight of application receipt","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"The GP enters eligible household particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"The GP issues a Job Card to eligible households within a fortnight of application","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office","evidence_ids":["E02"]}]}
